requirements.title: Implement paginated CRM API and database-side performance contract
requirements.expected_result: The CRM list endpoint enforces workspace/project in SQL with filters/sort/cursor pagination and the detail endpoint loads expensive timeline/conversation data only for the selected contact.
requirements.implementation_status: Locally implemented. The CRM list API accepts limit/cursor, defaults to 50 rows, caps at 100 rows, returns next_cursor/has_more metadata, caps source fetches by cursor window, keeps list payloads lightweight, and leaves expensive timeline data on the selected-contact timeline endpoint.
requirements.next_action: Continue the next unblocked batch. Production DB EXPLAIN/readback, deploy, and live smoke are centralized in REQ-20260712-112.
acceptance_criteria: List payload contains only lightweight row fields.
Detail payload loads timeline, notes, email, WhatsApp, tasks, membership/access, attribution, city/timezone after selection.
No per-row correlated subqueries across hundreds of rows.
Representative 10,000-contact list query meets the budget or records exact blocker.
verification: PASS node --test tests/crm-contact-model.test.js tests/rabbi-scheller-tenant-isolation-contract.test.js tests/one-time-view-as-scope-contract.test.js (15 tests passed, including 10,000-contact fixture)

requirements.title: Remove CRM root rerender and global data-loader side effects
requirements.expected_result: Initial CRM navigation requests only identity/scope, paginated list, and lightweight facets; contact selection loads selected detail only without global rerender.
requirements.implementation_status: Locally implemented. Operations CRM list/detail loading now uses a scoped CRM panel refresh instead of application-wide render on contact selection, sends CRM list/timeline fetches with AbortController signals, debounces search, caches normalized list queries, requests and renders at most 50 initial cards, keeps stale responses from painting, updates both the monolith fallback and split /operations shell, and lazy-constructs the legacy review/source table only when its details panel is opened.
requirements.next_action: Continue the next unblocked packet. Broad CRM/inbox UI remains REQ-20260712-107; shell/bundle performance budget remains REQ-20260712-111; commit/push/deploy/live-smoke remains REQ-20260712-112.
